verdict.rationale: Sprinto's documented webhooks are inbound only: they give external systems an endpoint URL to push data into Sprinto for ingestion workflows. They are not registrable outbound HTTP callbacks that let a consumer subscribe to Sprinto events. The only outbound notifications in the evidence are status-page emails, which do not count as webhooks, so the story is unsupported.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: Webhooks allow external systems to send data directly into Sprinto. Each webhook generates a unique endpoint URL that receives incoming requests from external services.
